scope: Curated source directory; links and research notes, not a redistributed asset pack. Exact downloaded items still need provenance.

rightsLabels.end-product: Use in a product; raw redistribution restricted

sources.name: gradients.sh
sources.bestFor: Moving light, dithered gradients and a focused hero.
sources.notes: Free components and presets allow commercial use with notices. Pro cannot be redistributed as a library, template or UI kit.

sources.name: Paper Shaders
sources.bestFor: Grain, mesh, liquid metal and material studies.
sources.notes: Keep the license and applicable notices; mark modified files. Use a static fallback and pause offscreen.

sources.name: Vanta
sources.bestFor: Atmospheric animated backgrounds.
sources.notes: Retain copyright and permission notices. Load only the selected effect and test GPU cost on phones.

sources.name: tsParticles
sources.bestFor: Particle fields, confetti and occasional celebrations.
sources.notes: Choose a small engine preset, cap particle count and stop for reduced motion. Retain license notices.

sources.name: Unsplash
sources.bestFor: Editorial, lifestyle and landscape photography.
sources.notes: Free collection has commercial use terms; Unsplash+ is separate. No unchanged resale or competing image service. API use has separate rules.

sources.name: Pexels
sources.bestFor: Human photography and short atmospheric footage.
sources.notes: No implied endorsement, unchanged resale, stock-platform redistribution or trademark use. API attribution requirements are separate.

sources.name: Pixabay
sources.bestFor: A broad fallback for images, clips and sound.
sources.notes: No standalone redistribution. Recognizable brands and people can carry additional rights; preserve the individual item record.

sources.name: Mixkit
sources.bestFor: Short footage, music and sound effects.
sources.notes: Video has both Free and Restricted licenses. Open the item license before commercial use; do not assume every free download has identical terms.

sources.name: Coverr
sources.bestFor: Ambient video and cinematic loops.
sources.notes: Commercial product use is allowed. No stock redistribution, competing services or AI datasets. Brands and property may need separate permission; API terms are separate.

sources.name: Open Peeps
sources.bestFor: Expressive hand-drawn people for onboarding.
sources.notes: Commercial use and modification allowed. Credit Pablo Stanley when practical; the linked Blush service has its own terms.

sources.name: Humaaans
sources.bestFor: Mix-and-match people and friendly scenes.
sources.notes: The original illustration library is CC0. Match the product palette and keep one illustration family per flow.

sources.name: Open Doodles
sources.bestFor: Loose, warm illustrations for empty and success states.
sources.notes: The original set is free for commercial and personal use. Check any separately linked service or commissioned work independently.

sources.name: unDraw
sources.bestFor: Simple recolorable product illustrations.
sources.notes: Commercial product use is allowed. No asset packs, competing service, integrations or AI training; link out rather than bundling a catalog.

sources.name: Kenney
sources.bestFor: Cohesive pixel worlds, playful UI and game assets.
sources.notes: Game assets on the asset pages are CC0. Keep each pack license; the Kenney logo and separately sold tools are not part of that grant.

sources.name: 0x72 DungeonTileset II
sources.bestFor: Tiny animated characters and a coherent dungeon palette.
sources.notes: The original pack explicitly allows reuse. Community extensions listed on its page have their own licenses.

sources.name: itch.io pixel art
sources.bestFor: Distinctive small-creator art packs.
sources.notes: Free price is not a reuse license. Read the specific creator terms for commercial use, modifications and redistribution.

sources.name: OpenGameArt
sources.license: CC0 / CC BY / CC BY-SA and others
sources.bestFor: Open game art, sprites and sound with explicit licenses.
sources.notes: Record the exact submission, author, selected license and attribution. Share-alike assets need a deliberate compatibility review.

sources.name: Lospec
sources.bestFor: Palette discovery and pixel-art technique.
sources.notes: Use as a palette and technique reference. Gallery artwork is not a reusable asset pack; obtain its separate permission.

sources.name: Poly Haven
sources.bestFor: Natural lighting, tactile materials and rendered scenes.
sources.notes: Downloadable assets are CC0. Website example renders and branding are separate. Optimize materials and meshes before web delivery.

sources.name: ambientCG
sources.bestFor: Paper, fabric, stone and physically based materials.
sources.notes: The asset files and material previews are CC0. Prefer small texture resolutions for a web composition.

sources.name: Quaternius
sources.bestFor: Low-poly characters, props and animated scenes.
sources.notes: Models allow commercial use and modification without attribution. Verify the specific pack contents and keep a lightweight static render fallback.

sources.name: Hero Patterns
sources.bestFor: Small repeatable patterns with configurable color.
sources.notes: Credit Steve Schoger, link the license and indicate changes. Use low contrast behind content.

sources.name: SVG Backgrounds
sources.bestFor: Geometric surfaces, textures and section dividers.
sources.notes: Free use requires attribution; subscription terms differ. No standalone redistribution or graphic-generation templates.

sources.name: Haikei
sources.bestFor: Generated waves, layers, blobs and compositions.
sources.notes: Generated designs may be downloaded, edited and used for personal or client commercial work. No credit required; do not use them to offer a similar design generator.

sources.name: Lucide
sources.bestFor: Consistent interface icons; already used by Fleet UI.
sources.notes: Keep the applicable copyright and permission notices, including Feather-derived icons. Prefer this existing set before adding another.

sources.name: Phosphor
sources.bestFor: A coherent icon family with multiple visual weights.
sources.notes: Retain notices. Choose one weight family per surface rather than mixing styles accidentally.

sources.name: Tabler Icons
sources.bestFor: An extensive outline and filled icon set.
sources.notes: Retain notices. Import only the icons used; keep stroke widths and optical size consistent.

sources.name: Iconify
sources.bestFor: Finding a missing symbol across many icon families.
sources.notes: Iconify software licensing does not replace each collection license. Brand marks also retain trademark constraints.

sources.name: Google Fonts
sources.bestFor: Display and text families with broad script support.
sources.notes: Read the family license file and reserved font names. Self-host subset WOFF2 files and avoid adding more families without a clear purpose.

sources.name: Bunny Fonts
sources.bestFor: An alternative delivery service for open web fonts.
sources.notes: The hosting service is separate from font licensing. Keep the selected family license; self-hosting avoids a runtime network dependency.

sources.name: LottieFiles
sources.bestFor: Short vector feedback and onboarding animations.
sources.notes: Public files under the Simple License retain those terms, including derivatives. Premium files differ. Do not compile a competing animation library.

sources.name: Rive Marketplace
sources.bestFor: Interactive vector characters and responsive diagrams.
sources.notes: Runtime software licenses do not grant rights to marketplace artwork. Verify each listing, editor plan and redistribution conditions.

sources.name: Motion
sources.bestFor: Gesture, layout and state transitions; already in Fleet UI.
sources.notes: Core library is MIT. Retain notices and use Fleet motion tokens; paid examples and courses have separate terms.

sources.name: GSAP
sources.bestFor: Complex timelines and scroll choreography.
sources.notes: License URL was temporarily unavailable during review. Do not label it MIT or assume demos and third-party assets share runtime terms.

sources.name: Freesound
sources.license: CC0 / CC BY / CC BY-NC and others
sources.bestFor: Subtle, optional interaction sounds.
sources.notes: Filter for a compatible commercial license and retain attribution. Never autoplay sound; keep a mute control and a silent default.
